_doc: Pair classification + per-pair equivalence rules (PROTOCOL §6-§7). gate: exact (int/string multiset), tolerance (numeric cells compared with relative tolerance for float reassociation), rows_only (unordered LIMIT -> row count only). sum_is_double flags float aggregates. shape: single_table | join. Wave-1 (p1-p3) + Wave-C (cq*/crt_*).

p1_count_fact.note: Bare COUNT(*) on FACT_ORDER. Metadata-vs-metadata on the shared catalog (DuckDB iceberg manifest stats; Fluree count-manifest shortcut #1478).

p2_category_rollup.note: FACT_ORDER_LINE JOIN DIM_PRODUCT, units by category, is_current filter. SUM(quantity) integer.

p3_open_tickets_by_segment.note: FACT_SUPPORT_TICKET JOIN DIM_CUSTOMER, open (status != Closed) tickets by segment. FILTER-over-join shape; the #1528 fusion discriminator. COUNT only.

cq038_count_current_customers.note: Un-fused filtered COUNT over DIM_CUSTOMER WHERE is_current. Headline DuckDB-win prediction (Fluree declines to full materialize).

cq014_channel_mix.note: Fused single-table COUNT + SUM(order_total double) by channel. Fluree-competitive prediction.

cq027_web_events_by_type_device.note: Largest single-table fused grouped COUNT (1M rows) by type+device. Fluree best-case prediction.

cq008_revenue_by_region.note: Fused fact->dim->dim rollup SUM(order_total double) by region (3-table star chain, trivially ordered).

cq040_store_values.note: VALUES/IN store constraint. Fluree ?store IRI reduced to trailing store_key for compare; raw order_total (double) cells compared numerically. DuckDB-win prediction (VALUES not lowered on virtual).

cq016_orders_optional_shipment.note: OPTIONAL (LEFT JOIN) fact-to-fact, unordered LIMIT 5000 -> row count only. DuckDB-win prediction (OPTIONAL swallows the LIMIT budget on virtual).

cq046_orders_top10.note: DESC top-k with a unique tiebreaker (exact top-10). order_total double compared numerically. Fluree-competitive prediction (99.9% file prune).

crt_join_reorder.note: RT: 4-table join with two selective dim filters (OrderLine->order->customer[Enterprise], OrderLine->product[current]). A hash-join-reorder decision. SUM(quantity) integer.

crt_minmax.note: RT: MIN/MAX of order_total. Answerable from Iceberg column stats; DuckDB-wins-now / Fluree-should-win-later. MIN/MAX deterministic (actual values), numeric compare.

crt_highcard_groupby.note: RT: high-cardinality GROUP BY (~customer count groups) over the 1M-row fact; run at normal memory AND with DuckDB memory_limit pinned LOW (spill candidate). customer_key IS NOT NULL matches SPARQL UNBOUND-omit. Large result fully materialized+sorted.
